ecosystem_evidence.interpretation: Speculative turnover remains exceptional and is not explained by passive net inflows alone. Negative 24h net inflows alongside rising DEX volume indicate unusually high capital velocity/recycling rather than simple new-money inflow.

primary_candidate.structural_evidence: CertiK currently reports no honeypot, no mintable function, no blacklist/whitelist, no modifiable tax, no sell restriction, no proxy, renounced owner privilege, and 0% buy/sell tax; major-holder ratio 13.92% excluding exchanges and locked addresses.
primary_candidate.leadership_evidence: Pons launchpad handled $370.2M on Sep 1, about 59% of Robinhood Chain launchpad volume, and PONS remained the chain's leading asset by market value and recent trading activity in contemporaneous reporting.
primary_candidate.attention_quality: No evidence found of a new paid DexScreener boost campaign for PONS; prior tracking showed one launch-week paid profile and no boosts.
unresolved: Selective-wallet convergence and funding independence among major wallets are still not independently verified.
Holder-count sources disagree because indexers update at different times; direction appears positive but exact acceleration should not be treated as precise.
The regime still contains heavy bot/arbitrage/recycled-volume components, so DEX volume is not equivalent to net capital inflow.

leadership_rotation.cashcat: Structurally clean on DexScreener and +19.97% over 24h at observation time, but current market cap (~$265M) and turnover remain below PONS leadership (~$348M).
leadership_rotation.artificial_inu: Narratively strong due AI/NVDA stock-token composability, but DexScreener still shows one Go+ security issue; hard gate remains uncleared.
leadership_rotation.chump: Emerging high-activity watch candidate with ~$36M market cap, ~$1.0M liquidity and no Go+/Quick Intel issues, but it currently carries a 500-unit DexScreener boost and lacks enough organic/persistent evidence to qualify.
leadership_rotation.jinqian: Rejected: one Go+ plus two Quick Intel issues and a >50% six-hour reversal despite extreme volume.
leadership_rotation.nudes: Rejected: one Go+ issue and only ~$440K liquidity despite strong momentum.
leadership_rotation.robloxians: Rejected: one Go+ issue, only ~$206K liquidity and paid boost activity despite extreme short-window gains.

why_it_matters_now: This is the first meaningful post-entry forward-test milestone: PONS has crossed the previously frozen +10% scale-confirmation price while Robinhood Chain's speculative regime remains exceptionally strong and liquidity has not deteriorated. This observation records the event without changing the original paper rules or recommending/executing a trade.
